decisions.reason: Having survived the first post-launch years while several other 2018 launches disappeared quickly, this product likely meets at least minimum aspirations, fits closely with the core heat-exchanger business, and in a growing, R&D-active firm there is enough slack to retain it unless clearer underperformance appears.

This product is highly aligned with the firm's engineering and innovation capabilities, appears to have lasted beyond the initial market test, and under a behavioral-theory view a firm with growth, hiring, and technical search capacity would usually keep such a strategically related product unless results fell clearly below aspiration levels.
